note_tweet.text: MoonBit is already more token efficient than Rust in our internal benchmark with the latest model. We have an early prototype which will make MoonBit 10x compile faster, this will add up to 100x compile time faster than Rust. So MoonBit will cover lots of use cases Rust cannot be used.

urls.description: Golem runs AI agents and their tools, and serves their artifacts to users. Each agent runs in a lightweight WebAssembly VM. After a crash, node restart, rescaling or long wait, the whole VM resumes mid‑function with its memory and files. Tool calls run exactly once, under permissions agents can't bypass.
urls.title: Golem: the durable runtime for AI agents
